18028301ae.why: Four 32-byte stores are required at AVX2 width, and vzeroupper is needed to match the final ymm0.

528b09a11f.rewrite:
vpbroadcastb xmm0,esi
lea rsi,[rdi+rdx*1]
mov rax,rdi
cmp rdx,0x10
528b09a11f.why: The AVX-512 byte broadcast replaces the zeroing, scalar move, and byte shuffle while preserving the low-byte replication and zeroing zmm0 above bit 127.

c5b316cefb.why: The live rsi adjustment, 64-byte store, and two operations that advance rdi to the next 64-byte boundary are all needed.

04bcc4fcdc.why: The four maximum-width stores, live rdi update, and comparison producing the required CF each need their own instruction.

9809e27b86.why: The two maximum-width stores, live rsi adjustment, and two operations that advance rdi to the next 128-byte boundary are all needed.

89dd6acada.why: Scaling rdx, broadcasting esi, copying rdi to rax, and producing the comparison flags are distinct required effects.

e5c2b08cc4.why: Zeroing zmm16, setting both live scalar destinations, and producing the comparison flags each require an instruction.

e17f5ecb4e.why: The two maximum-width stores, live rcx address calculation, and comparison producing CF and ZF are all required.

8c6866be1c.why: The four maximum-width stores, live rdi update, and comparison producing CF cannot be combined into fewer instructions.

f22c772c63.why: Scaling rdx, broadcasting esi with the required upper-register zeroing, copying rdi to rax, and producing the comparison flags each require an instruction.

654cf359ac.why: Zeroing zmm16, setting both live scalar destinations, and producing the comparison flags each require an instruction.

47ad781dc2.why: Both live address calculations and the comparison are needed, and combining the two stores would require an additional instruction to duplicate their vector data.

a8ffaa29d3.rewrite:
vinserti64x4 zmm1,zmm16,ymm16,0x1
vmovdqu64 ZMMWORD PTR [rdi],zmm1
vmovdqu64 ZMMWORD PTR [rdi+0x40],zmm1
sub rdi,0xffffffffffffff80
cmp rdi,rcx
a8ffaa29d3.why: Duplicating ymm16 into both halves of a scratch ZMM register lets two unaligned 64-byte stores write the same bytes as the four original stores. The pointer update, comparison, and full zmm16 value are preserved.

d663ecf55f.why: SSE2 needs both the scalar move and shuffle for the dword broadcast, in addition to the required rdx scaling, rax copy, and comparison.

8dd78915d4.why: The rax copy, transfer of the original rsi into rdx, clearing of rsi, and final comparison are all required.

7d7c30475a.why: The SSE2 byte broadcast needs the scalar move and three replication instructions, while the rax copy and comparison must also remain.

40bf1a9a9d.why: SSE2 requires both 16-byte stores, and the live rdi addition and comparison producing CF and ZF are independently necessary.

9d15be17f5.why: Both 16-byte stores, the live rdi adjustment, and the comparison producing CF and ZF are required.

5afbb1b3e2.why: SSE2 requires four stores for these 64 bytes, followed by the live rdx update and comparison producing CF.

7cbfa9ccc4.why: The four comparisons and three OR operations form the required rcx mask, and mask extraction, the live pointer update, and a flag-setting test are also needed.
